clue.text: No meal cubs cooked is fit to eat

indicators.note: food that is cooked has been worked over, so these three words are mixed into a new order

explanation.surface: A dish of no meal and cooked cubs is declared edible.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cooked' signals an anagram of NO MEAL CUBS (ten letters) to give the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Something edible, safe and suitable to be eaten, can be described this way.

clue.text: After surgery I took drug

indicators.note: the pieces 'I took' are placed following the piece for surgery

parts.note: OP is short for operation, a piece of surgery
taken as written
took food, ate

explanation.surface: Someone recalls being given drugs after an operation.
explanation.definitionFit: An opiate is a narcotic made from opium, a kind of drug.

clue.text: One's liable to damage shoe climbing street in Paris

parts.note: a sabot is a wooden clog, a type of shoe

indicators.note: in a down clue, going upward means the letters read from bottom to top

parts.note: rue is the French word for street

explanation.surface: Someone may scuff their footwear walking up a Paris street.
explanation.walkthrough: 'climbing' turns RUE into EUR beneath SABOT; the clog was supposedly thrown into machinery by wreckers.
explanation.definitionFit: A wrecker who deliberately harms equipment or plans is someone given to causing damage.

clue.text: Flower-girl whose Spanish counterpart gets drunk

definitions.text: Flower-girl whose Spanish counterpart gets drunk

parts.words: Flower-girl whose Spanish counterpart gets drunk
parts.note: a daisy that is also a girl's name; the Spanish form of the name, Margarita, is a tequila cocktail that people drink

explanation.surface: A girl selling flowers has a Spanish friend who gets tipsy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gets drunk' reads as getting tipsy but means is consumed as a drink.
explanation.definitionFit: The ox-eye daisy is called by this name, which is also a French woman's name.

clue.text: Mistake, planting elm stupidly in bad spot

indicators.note: planting something puts it into the ground, so one piece is set inside the other

parts.note: bish is British slang for a blunder

indicators.note: acting stupidly means behaving in a muddled way, so these letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: A gardener errs by planting an elm in a poor location.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mistake' looks like the definition but is British slang for a blunder; 'stupidly' yields LEM, which 'planting' sets within it.
explanation.definitionFit: A mark or flaw that spoils the look of skin or a surface is an unsightly spot.

clue.text: Procure pot, we hear

indicators.note: what we hear is spoken, so the word for pot is matched by its sound

parts.note: an urn is a pot or vase

explanation.surface: An instruction to obtain a pot, as heard.
explanation.walkthrough: In a non-rhotic British accent the words for pot and gain sound the same.
explanation.definitionFit: To gain money or reward by working is to obtain or get it.

clue.text: Order me a lilac or another shrub

indicators.note: to order is to arrange, so these letters are set out in a new sequence

explanation.surface: A request to a nursery to send a lilac or some other bush.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Order' signals an anagram of ME A LILAC.
explanation.definitionFit: This evergreen with glossy leaves and showy blooms is a flowering bush, a second one after the lilac.

clue.text: Tar uses mat, shuffling part of foot

indicators.note: shuffling cards mixes them, so these words are mixed up

explanation.surface: A doormat gets tarred as feet drag across it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shuffling' signals an anagram of TAR USES MAT.
explanation.definitionFit: The five long bones between ankle and toes form this section of the foot.

clue.text: A form of punishment king's concealed in secret

indicators.note: a thing concealed in another is placed within it

parts.note: taken as written
the cane was a school punishment
R stands for Rex, Latin for king

explanation.surface: A king hides a cane in a secret place.
explanation.walkthrough: 'concealed in' puts R inside A CANE.
explanation.definitionFit: Something mysterious, known only to a few, is obscure or hidden.

clue.text: Some troops are in flight

definitions.meaning: parachute or glider soldiers form such units

explanation.surface: Paratroops are described as flying.
explanation.definitionFit: The word describes both soldiers landed from aircraft and anything aloft, flying.

clue.text: Huge area needed for climbing plant

parts.note: monster as an adjective means huge

explanation.surface: A vast space is required for a vine.
explanation.definitionFit: The Swiss cheese plant is a tropical climber of this genus.

clue.text: Hope kennel confines this dog

indicators.note: the phrase confines, encloses, the answer within its letters

explanation.surface: A dog owner hopes the kennel can keep the pet in.
explanation.walkthrough: 'confines' signals letters run across hoPE KEnnel.
explanation.definitionFit: Short for Pekingese, a small long-haired toy breed of dog.

clue.text: Some land job in delivery service

parts.note: a parcel is a plot or piece of land
a post is a job or position

explanation.surface: Someone takes a farming job in the delivery trade.
explanation.definitionFit: A postal system for sending packages is a branch of mail delivery.

clue.text: Part of the country that's against ale? That's daft!

indicators.note: daft means silly or crazy, so these letters are mixed up

explanation.surface: A region is accused of opposing beer, which is called silly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'daft' signals an anagram of AGAINST ALE. EAST ANGLIA is the region of eastern England holding Norfolk and Suffolk.
explanation.definitionFit: A region of England, comprising Norfolk, Suffolk and parts of neighbouring counties.

clue.text: He's'bound to learn

parts.note: read as a person tied by an indenture to an employer in order to learn a trade, rather than one certain to learn

explanation.surface: Someone is sure to pick things up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bound' seems to mean certain but means legally tied by indentures.
explanation.definitionFit: A trainee bound by contract to a master craftsman for a period while learning a trade.

clue.text: Forbear's burden

definitions.meaning: to hold back or abstain from doing something
the burden of a song is its chorus

explanation.surface: An ancestor's heavy load.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Forbear' looks like forebear, an ancestor, but is the verb meaning abstain.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both to abstain from an action and a repeated chorus of a song.

clue.text: Song and dance created by soldier under fire

indicators.note: in a down clue, the soldier piece sits below the fire piece

parts.note: a flame is fire
NCO is a non-commissioned officer, a soldier

explanation.surface: A performance produced by a soldier under attack.
explanation.walkthrough: 'under fire' suggests being shot at, but places NCO below FLAME.
explanation.definitionFit: The Spanish Gypsy style of music and dance from Andalusia, both singing and stamping steps.

clue.text: Seems to be listening avidly when learners turn very quiet

indicators.note: the learners turn into, become, the very quiet sign

parts.note: someone all ears is listening keenly
L is a learner driver, so two Ls are learners
pp, pianissimo, is the musical direction for very quiet

explanation.surface: An eager audience goes silent once the students are hushed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turn' means LL in ALL EARS becomes PP.
explanation.definitionFit: To give the impression of being something is to look or come across that way.

clue.text: Attractive way to finish off making 14

indicators.note: the finishing stretch of the word is kept, its opening letters dropped

parts.note: making someone an apprentice is apprenticing them

explanation.surface: An appealing way to complete a trainee's making.
explanation.walkthrough: 'way to finish off' keeps the closing eight letters of APPRENTICING, dropping APPR.
explanation.definitionFit: Something alluring or tempting draws people towards it.

clue.text: Clerical cover-up at the highest level?

definitions.text: Clerical cover-up at the highest level?

parts.words: Clerical cover-up at the highest level?
parts.note: read not as a scandal hushed up by top churchmen but as headwear, a cover for the topmost part of a cleric

explanation.surface: Senior churchmen hush up a scandal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cover-up' suggests concealment but means a hat on the head, the body's highest level.
explanation.definitionFit: A stiff square cap worn by Roman Catholic priests is a churchman's headwear.

clue.text: Attempt to convert fallen woman — pure female is brought in

indicators.note: these pieces are brought into the other, placed inside it

parts.note: Eve fell from grace in Eden
an angel is a pure, virtuous woman
taken as written

explanation.surface: A missionary tries to reform a fallen woman by introducing a virtuous one.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fallen woman' is the biblical first woman, who fell from grace; 'brought in' is the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: To preach the gospel is to try to win people over to Christianity.

clue.text: Hardy heroine in fix, rejected by spouse initially

indicators.note: rejected means turned back, so the word is read in reverse

parts.note: to set is to fix

indicators.note: initially points to the opening letter of the word spouse

explanation.surface: A Thomas Hardy heroine in trouble is cast off by her husband.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rejected' turns SET to TES; Tess of the d'Urbervilles is spurned by her husband Angel.
explanation.definitionFit: The title character of Thomas Hardy's novel Tess of the d'Urbervilles.

clue.text: Run unfinished, having collected a form of injury

indicators.note: the shortened word collects, takes inside it, the next piece
unfinished means the final letter is missing

parts.note: to sprint is to run fast
taken as written

explanation.surface: A runner pulls up before the finish, having picked up an injury.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unfinished' cuts SPRINT to SPRIN; 'having collected' puts A inside.
explanation.definitionFit: A wrenched ankle or wrist with torn ligaments is this kind of hurt.

clue.text: Pressure with backlog resulting in jam?

parts.note: P is the symbol for pressure in physics
a reserve is a stock or backlog held back

explanation.surface: Stress plus a pile of work leaves one stuck in a tight spot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'jam' suggests a predicament, but means fruit spread.
explanation.definitionFit: A fruit conserve boiled with sugar, a spread for bread.

clue.text: Oversees functions

definitions.meaning: manages or is in charge of

explanation.surface: A manager supervises and keeps things working.
explanation.definitionFit: The verb means both to manage something and, of a machine, to operate.

clue.text: Secret society hiding racket back in island

indicators.note: the society hides, encloses, the other piece

parts.note: a triad is a Chinese secret criminal society

indicators.note: back means the letters go in reverse order

parts.note: din is a loud noise, racket

explanation.surface: A gang conceals a racket offshore.
explanation.walkthrough: A triad is a Chinese criminal gang; 'back' yields NID, and 'hiding' is the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: The larger of the two Caribbean islands making up a nation with Tobago.

clue.text: Become unwell as neck is twisted

indicators.note: twisted means wrenched out of shape, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone feels ill after cricking their neck.
explanation.walkthrough: 'twisted' signals an anagram of NECK IS.
explanation.definitionFit: To fall ill, or start to feel nauseous, is to grow poorly.

clue.text: Cleaning up, that is, and settling score

parts.note: sc. abbreviates scilicet, Latin for namely or that is
avenging a wrong is settling a score

explanation.surface: A tidy-up is described as getting even.
explanation.walkthrough: SC (scilicet) is a dictionary abbreviation meaning namely.
explanation.definitionFit: Clearing away refuse or carrion; the word once meant street cleaning.
